title: Enabling Agents and Battling Bots on an AI-Centric Web

reader_summary.headline: 50% of traffic is already automated and agents are only really just getting going.
reader_summary.overview: 50% of traffic is already automated and agents are only really just getting going. Most people are not using these computer use agents because they're too slow right now. They're still like previews, but it's clear that's where everything is going.

key_points.text: AI agents are changing how people interact with the web, but most sites still treat them like bots.

key_points.text: In this episode, take it from the AI plus A16Z podcast.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, take it from the AI plus A16Z podcast, A16Z partner Joel De LaGarza talks with ArcGets CEO David Mitten about building internet infrastructure for this new era.

thesis: The episode argues that blocking all automated traffic based on AI labels is a blunt instrument that risks preventing legitimate user actions like making reservations or purchasing products. Instead, site owners must use application-level context to distinguish between harmful bots and beneficial AI agents acting on behalf of humans.
